description: Given a spend category, return the best card in the user's portfolio ranked by effective value per dollar spent. Uses stored CPP valuations by default. Accept cpp_override to adjust valuations for specific redemptions.

amount.description: Purchase amount in dollars for points-earned calculation

category.description: Spend category: dining, groceries, gas, travel, flights, hotels, transit, streaming, online_shopping, base

include_sub_priority.description: Boost cards with active welcome offers (default: true). Set false for steady-state ranking without SUB influence.

name: get_best_card
